actions.description: Start service and verify contract endpoints
actions.command:
systemctl reset-failed builder-app.service && systemctl start builder-app.service && systemctl is-active builder-app.service && systemctl is-enabled builder-app.service && printf '
--- health ---
' && curl --fail --silent --show-error --include http://127.0.0.1:8080/health && printf '
--- put ---
' && curl --fail --silent --show-error --include --request PUT --data-binary 'durable payload' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/smoke-test && printf '
--- get ---
' && curl --fail --silent --show-error --include http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/smoke-test
